review.posthog_relevance: Adds error handling and diagnostics for Fillout warehouse ingestion, distinguishing 400 Bad Request failures from authentication errors.
review.reason: Adds a non-retryable error entry and corresponding test assertion for Fillout 400 Bad Request responses. This could help PostHog warehouse ingestion distinguish Fillout-specific request failures from transient or authentication failures, potentially preventing unnecessary retries and improving error diagnostics for warehouse users.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of distinguishing this specific error and preventing retries is not demonstrated by the code alone; the implementation could be a narrow maintenance update rather than a systemic improvement. No production incident or adoption is verified.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
